sources.title: Leona Build Guide: Chosen Of The Sun

passive.name: Sunlight
passive.text: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

spells.name: Shield of Daybreak
spells.text: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

spells.name: Eclipse
spells.text: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

spells.name: Zenith Blade
spells.text: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

spells.name: Solar Flare
spells.text: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

damage.value: Leona deals burst magic damage through her abilities and Sunlight procs.

archetype.value: Leona is a vanguard tank who engages and absorbs damage for her team.

winCondition.value: Leona wins by locking down targets, setting up picks, and frontlining around objectives.

spikes.why: Leona becomes very durable with Eclipse.
Leona can use her dash more often than at its 12-second cooldown.

mistakes.value: Leona cannot prolong Eclipse’s defenses unless enemies are nearby when its duration first ends.
